The '''Heinz Hopf Prize''' is awarded every two years at [[ETH Zurich]]. The prize honours ''outstanding scientific work in the field of [[pure mathematics]]''. It is named after the German mathematician [[Heinz Hopf]] (1894–1971), Professor of Mathematics at ETH from 1931 to 1965. The prize is awarded on the occasion of the Heinz Hopf Lectures that are given at ETH by the laureate.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Heinz Hopf Prize and Lectures |url=https://math.ethz.ch/news-and-events/events/lecture-series/heinz-hopf-prize-and-lectures.html |access-date=2022-08-09 |website=math.ethz.ch |language=en}}</ref>

The prize was awarded for the first time in October 2009.
